falsifierDetail.theTwoDefectsTheFalsifierActuallyCaught: violate.mjs found TWO REAL INSTRUMENT DEFECTS ON ITS FIRST RUN, and both produced a PASS rather than an error. (1) A plant that stripped the coverage panel's structured counting-rule element was NOT caught, because the rule matched the counting rule's TEXT anywhere in the page and the panel's basis line carries the same words - the rule was reading the prose it was meant to check. It now requires the rule inside a data-coverage-rule="documents" element. (2) A plant that put a person's name in a table cell was NOT caught, because the cell extractor keys on the rendered style of the cell spans and gen.mjs was not applying that style to the result spans - so the extractor matched ZERO cells and every rule over cells was passing vacuously. Both are the dispatch's named failure mode and neither was visible from a green run.
